reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a loan of up to USD 301 million in local currency split into two tranches under a sovereign guarantee to JSC KazAvtoZhol, 100 per cent state-owned national road operator. The first tranche of an amount equivalent to USD 235 million will finance the reconstruction of a 217 km long Atyrau Astrakhan road section of Trans-Caspian Road Transit Corridor. The second uncommitted tranche of an amount equivalent USD 66 million will finance construction of a 26 km bypass around Atyrau city adjacent to the road. * Reconstruction of the 217 km long Atyrau Astrakhan road in Kazakhstan. * Construction of a 26 km bypass around Atyrau city in Kazakhstan. * Contribution to the improved inter-regional connectivity, safety standards, increased road capacity and reduced travel time.
